name: NOVA-PROX01
role: Proxmox VE, nested in VMware Workstation on one Windows 11 host
limit: Archives exist for some VMs, but a whole-VM restore has not been demonstrated.

links.meaning: Proxmox hosts every virtual machine above it

story: Proxmox is the platform under everything. It runs nested inside VMware Workstation on one Windows 11 host, and it hosts all five virtual machines: the firewall, both domain controllers, the file server and the test workstation. I built it first (CR-001), and every later change depends on it. It also holds the backup repository and the snapshots I use as rollback points. When old snapshots filled its storage to 86.73%, I cleaned them up (CR-015).
